answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the comet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the kernel is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
